properties.text: On January 29th, 2026, @palawdali and @stopyourliesnyt took to Times Square to host a vigil for Hind Rajab and children martyred by the genocidal state of Israel, in commemoration of the 2-year anniversary of her killing by Israeli Occupation Forces as Red Crescent workers responded to her 9-1-1 call before meeting their own death.
